local.h: Atlanta jail sale could be finalized Monday
local.b: The city council could approve selling the Atlanta City Detention Center to Fulton County for $68 million.
local.title: Atlanta City Council could make final decision on sale of city's jail

local.h: Court ruling could shift fire costs to taxpayers
local.b: The Georgia Supreme Court struck down Chatham County's fire fee as an illegal property tax, ordering about $30 million in refunds.
local.title: GA Supreme Court ruling could shift fire costs to property taxpayers

local.h: Miller, Strickland clash in Georgia AG race
local.b: Democrat Tanya Miller and Republican Brian Strickland split on police surveillance, data centers and public records in the race to succeed Chris Carr.
local.title: Miller, Strickland clash over surveillance, records in GA AG race

local.b: Prosecutors say Alexandros Paporakis, 19, a self-described neo-Nazi, spent two years planning a mass shooting and targeted the temple for two months.

local.h: Illinois erases $1.4B in medical debt
local.b: The state's Medical Debt Relief Program has wiped out an average of $1,200 for thousands of residents, Gov. JB Pritzker said.
local.title: Illinois erases $1.4 billion in medical debt for thousands of residents

local.h: Judge halts smelly South Side feed plant
local.b: A judge temporarily stopped operations at a Pullman animal feed plant, the source of hundreds of odor complaints, until at least a Jan. 14 hearing.

local.h: Peak Fire near Azusa prompts evacuations
local.b: The brush fire north of San Gabriel Canyon Road has burned about 22 acres and threatens structures, amid a red flag warning.
local.title: Peak Fire grows to 22 acres near Azusa, prompting evacuation orders

local.h: Long Beach housing nonprofit accused of fraud
local.b: Helpful Housing, which controls hundreds of Long Beach apartments, faces accusations it cheated the government out of tens of millions; its head is in federal custody.

local.h: Big Bear eagle Jackie died of bird flu complications
local.b: A necropsy found avian influenza caused a severe stomach ulcer, leading to internal bleeding, anemia and sepsis, wildlife officials said.
local.title: Jackie the bald eagle died from ‘multiple severe’ illnesses, wildlife officials say

local.h: LAUSD starts making case for school closures
local.b: With 40% fewer students than in the early 2000s but nearly as many schools, the district is beginning community meetings on closures and consolidation.
local.title: LAUSD begins to make the case for school closures, with many questions yet to be answered

local.h: Pilot offers nearly free daytime electricity
local.b: A new California pilot tests whether nearly free power during sunny hours can shift use toward surplus solar energy.

local.h: Street homelessness spending tripled, and so did need
local.b: The state comptroller found NYC spending on street homelessness and related 311 calls both tripled since 2019.
local.title: NYC spending on homelessness has soared. So has the number of people on the street.

local.h: Citi Bike expands into seven more neighborhoods
local.b: The bike-share network finished adding docks in areas including parts of the North Bronx and eastern Brooklyn, the city said.
local.title: Citi Bike finishes expansion into 7 areas, including parts of North Bronx, Eastern Brooklyn

local.h: Comptroller backs off pension investment in Israel bonds
local.b: NYC Comptroller Mark Levine said he won't invest city pension funds in Israel bonds.
local.title: Early Addition: NYC comptroller backs off investing city pension funds in Israel bonds

local.h: Police investigate death of 5-year-old in Queens
local.b: Police found the girl unconscious after an apparent assault at a Richmond Hill home Wednesday evening, after her mother called 911.
local.title: Queens mother told police 'I killed my daughter' on 911 call, NYPD says

local.h: Minibus hits train near Channel Tunnel, 19 hurt
local.b: A minibus carrying truck drivers collided with a train near the tunnel entrance; five were severely injured but none appeared in danger.
local.title: Several injured after bus hits train near Channel Tunnel entrance in France

local.h: Teen charged in Aubagne school shooting
local.b: A 14-year-old who wounded a principal and teacher with hunting pellets near Marseille was charged with attempted murder and cited revenge for bullying.
local.title: France charges teen shooter citing revenge for bullying in school

local.h: Zelensky defends France ties after Le Pen remarks
local.b: Zelensky called defence cooperation with France "win-win" after Marine Le Pen said she would cut aid to Kyiv if elected.
local.title: Zelensky stresses 'win-win' cooperation with France after Le Pen comments

local.h: Paris taxi drivers stage airport blockades
local.b: About 2,000 taxi drivers planned rolling roadblocks toward Charles de Gaulle on Thursday to protest competition from ride-hail drivers, with action possible through Saturday.

local.h: 12 million French homes at risk of drought cracks
local.b: About a third of French houses sit on clay soils that shrink and swell, a risk worsened by the record 2026 drought.

local.h: Homelessness authority's budget hole hits $16.7M
local.b: The deeper King County Regional Homelessness Authority deficit renewed calls from some officials to dissolve the agency.
local.title: KCRHA’s financial hole grows to $16.7 million, renewing calls to dissolve agency

local.h: Seattle inflation outpaces West Coast peers
local.b: Seattle-area prices rose 4.4% over the past year versus 3.4% nationally, driven mainly by energy costs.
local.title: Seattle inflation outpaces most West Coast peers, national average. What's driving it?

local.h: WA drops LGBTQ+ support rule for foster parents
local.b: Under a settlement with a religious couple, the state can no longer require foster parents to provide affirming homes for LGBTQ+ youth.
local.title: WA foster parents no longer have to support LGBTQ+ kids in their care
